# agent-swarm

Intro paragraph.

## Selection contract

<!-- Read by packages/research-enrich to judge whether a document belongs in this topic. English on purpose. -->

- **Purpose:** How many LLM agents coordinate as a swarm: the runtimes, the patterns, and what large multi-agent systems do in practice.
- **Core:** Swarm runtimes and patterns (OpenAI Swarm, LangGraph, Haystack, Strands, kyegomez/swarms, Kimi agent swarm, Claude agent teams) and writing on coordination, interruption, scaling middleware, and self-evolution of LLM multi-agent systems.
- **Adjacent (keep):** Multi-agent RL, enterprise multi-agent design, and application writeups such as the drug-discovery swarm, plus the indexed KISS Sorcar runtime, because the source index keeps that general agent runtime in this set.
- **Collected on purpose:** Product posts, glossaries, and GitHub READMEs for a named swarm product (AbacusAI, ClawTeam, kyegomez/swarms), and the indexed n8n tutorial that coordinates an agent swarm.
- **Out of scope:** Docker Swarm and other container orchestrators; numerical particle-swarm optimization with no LLM agents; biological swarms with no LLM agents; step-by-step coding lessons that show one agent and never a swarm runtime; no-code recipes that never hand work between two or more agents.
